name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic LED Light Display Stand
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality acrylic material.
    - Acrylic thickness: 4mm.
    - Precision laser-cut custom shape.
    - Sturdy acrylic kickstand for stable tabletop display.
    - Includes LED light base made from ABS material.
    - Durable and long-lasting construction.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main acrylic panel: 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.
    - LED light base size: 3.55 in x 1.58 in ~ 9 x 4 cm.
    - Kickstand Dimensions:
                    +) Overall height: 1.57 in ~ 4 cm.
                    +) Slot height (insert depth): 0.63 in ~ 1.6 cm.
                    +) Slot width: ≥ 0.31 in ~ 0.8 cm.
                    +) Inner gap width: 0.15 in ~ 0.375 cm.
                    +) Base width: 2.8 in ~ 7.1 cm.
                    +) Side leg width: 0.79 in ~ 2 cm.
    📌 Note: 
    - The LED light base and kickstand dimensions are fixed and cannot be changed. 
    - The size of the main acrylic panel may vary slightly depending on the design, as it is not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Advanced UV printing technology.
    - Sharp details and vibrant colors.
    - Scratch-resistant and fade-resistant finish.
    - Available options:
                    +) Print One Side: 1-sided printing (front only)
                    +) Print Both Sides: 2-sided printing (front & back)

 

  • Lighting Features:
    - LED base supports 7 colors without a remote
    - Includes remote control with 16 color options
    - Adjustable brightness levels
    - Lighting modes:
                    +) Flash Mode
                    +) Strobe Mode
                    +) Fade Mode
                    +) Smooth Mode
    - Powered by 3 AA batteries (not included)
    📌 Note: Please remove the plastic sheet from the remote before use.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative tabletop LED display.
    - Ideal for bedrooms, gaming rooms, desks, and shelves.
    - Perfect as a night light or ambient lighting.
    - Personalized custom design for sports themes, names, logos, or characters.
    - Easy to assemble and insert into the LED base.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Unique personalized LED décor gift
    - Great for birthdays, holidays, and celebrations
    - Perfect for sports lovers, kids, and collectors
    - Eye-catching display piece that combines art and lighting
    - A creative keepsake that lights up memories in a special way 🎁.
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic LED Light Display Stand

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
